context: Riku tells Aoi about a surprising day.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (再び/なんだか/びっくり/無駄/いきなり) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今日、いきなり先生に呼ばれたんだ。
lines.en: Today the teacher suddenly called me.
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: えっ、びっくりしたでしょ?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、なんだか怒られるかと思った。
lines.en: Yeah, I somehow thought I'd be scolded.
lines.style: rueful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 心配は、無駄だったってこと?
lines.en: So the worry was for nothing?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そう、無駄に緊張しちゃったよ。
lines.en: Right, I got nervous for nothing.
lines.style: laughing teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 再び呼ばれたら、また驚くね。
lines.en: If you're called again, you'll be surprised again.
lines.style: playful barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いきなりだと、びっくりするよなー。
lines.en: When it's sudden, you do get startled.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: なんだか、笑える話だね!
lines.style: giggly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
